subject: What professional fitting protects
hook: Good fitting is invisible. Bad fitting shows up six months later.
ig:
Good fitting is invisible. Bad fitting shows up six months later.

You can buy a well-made unit and still end up with doors that drift, gaps at the wall and a shelf that sags. Most of that comes down to installation. Here's what a careful fit protects:

Alignment. Units set level and true keep door gaps even and soft-close working as it should.

The wall line. Scribed fillers follow the shape of the wall so there's no tapering gap.

Fixings. Plasterboard, brick and block each need the right fixing for the load.

Services. Checking for pipes and cables before drilling.

Your home. Floors protected and panels handled so nothing is marked on the way in.

Our own team installs the furniture we make, and we also fit other manufacturers' furniture.

Save this list for whoever fits your next piece, and find our installation service through the link in bio.
fb:
Ever had a wardrobe door that slowly stopped lining up, or a little gap down the side of a unit that never quite looked right? That's usually the fitting, not the furniture.

A proper install keeps units level so doors stay aligned, scribes fillers to the shape of your walls, uses the right fixings for plasterboard or brick, checks for pipes and cables before drilling, and protects your floors throughout.

Our own team fits everything we make, and we install other manufacturers' furniture too.

on_asset:
S1: What good fitting quietly protects / Six things you won't see on the day |
S2: Doors that stay aligned — Units fixed level and true keep door gaps even. Fitted out of level, doors drift and soft-close stops closing softly. |
S3: The gap at the wall — Walls bow and corners aren't square. Fillers scribed to the wall profile close gaps that would otherwise collect dust. |
S4: Fixings into the right thing — Plasterboard, brick and block each need different fixings. The wrong one works until the unit is loaded up. |
S5: Pipes and cables behind — Checking for services before drilling avoids the worst kind of surprise in a wall. |
S6: Your floors and finishes — Protection down first, panels handled with care, edges kept clean. The furniture arrives once; damage lasts. |
S7: Fitting is part of the furniture — Save this, and ask any fitter how they handle all five. Link in bio for our installation service. |
